description: This file defines the Coocook::DeploymentHandler package, which customizes deployment handling for a database schema, including upgrade procedures and index name mangling, specifically tailored for SQLite and other databases.

classes.name: Coocook::DeploymentHandler
classes.description: A Perl package extending DBIx::Class::DeploymentHandler to customize deployment and upgrade behavior, especially for SQLite databases.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the deployment handler, checks the script directory, and converts it to an absolute path.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema upgrade, with special handling for SQLite to disable foreign key checks during upgrade.
